analysis:
The only change in docs/provider/cli-reference.md is one added documentation table row at head line 1960, which describes the env var DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_INCREMENTAL_CHECKPOINTS (SSDPrefixCachePolicy.incrementalCheckpoints; a negative value writes complete checkpoints instead of deltas). No code or controls change. The two supplied units (head lines 397-1289) are unchanged surrounding documentation about logout, stop/restart, status, doctor and add-on holds, and they do not touch the patched line, which falls outside the supplied unit ranges. I read them for context only and found nothing new there.

Security relevance: the new row concerns the encrypted SSD prefix cache (T-041 / SEC-035). The documented knob changes the checkpoint write format (delta vs complete). It does not appear to alter the T-041 posture: DBK3 crypto, HMAC lookup tags, the 30-minute TTL, salt scoping and the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch. I can only confirm what the row says; the underlying code in SSDPrefixCachePolicy.swift was not supplied.

Open question for integration: whether incremental delta checkpoints add on-disk metadata, such as parent links or delta chain identifiers, that is not covered by the HMAC-only lookup tag rule in T-041's detection_hint, and whether the delta AAD still binds the cacheSalt and model. T-041 may need an update if incremental checkpoints were introduced by an accompanying code change. That code change is outside this documentation-only unit, and no evidence of a regression is visible here.

The logout, drain and add-on text is consistent with the A-008, TB-011 and TB-012 descriptions in the canonical context. It shows no contradiction with them, such as the logout revoke sending the token only to the recorded issuer, with confirmation only on HTTP 204.
